description: This file defines repository classes for database interactions in the Sports Telecast Backend. It includes classes for users, profiles, matches, events, emojis, and highlights, encapsulating various database operations and queries related to these entities.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: Base class providing common database session access.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Handles user-related database operations such as create, retrieve, and update.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Manages user profile creation, retrieval, and updates.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Provides methods for fetching match data, including filtering by status, sport, and time frame.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Handles event data retrieval, including associated matches.

classes.name: EmojiRepository
classes.description: Manages emoji assets and reactions, including adding reactions and summarizing reactions for events.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Handles operations related to highlights, including fetching, featured, and by match.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Updates existing user information.

methods.name: UserProfileDB create_profile(self, profile_data: UserProfileCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user profile.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_user_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a profile by user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_id(self, profile_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a profile by profile ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] update_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: UserProfileUpdate)
methods.description: Updates an existing user profile.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None, sport: Optional[SportType] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of matches with optional filters.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches detailed data for a specific match.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Retrieves all currently live matches.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Fetches upcoming matches within a specified time window.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_more_matches(self, limit: int = 12, offset: int = 0, exclude_ids: List[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a diverse set of matches, including live, recent finished, upcoming, and others.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport: Optional[SportType] = None, featured: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events with optional filters.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches event details along with associated matches.

methods.name: List[EmojiAssetDB] get_emojis(self, limit: int = 10, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Lists emoji assets with pagination.

methods.name: Optional[EmojiAssetDB] get_emoji_by_id(self, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an emoji asset by ID.

methods.name: str add_reaction(self, user_id: str, event_id: str, emoji_id: str)
methods.description: Adds an emoji reaction for an event by a user.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_reaction_summary(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Provides a summary of reactions for a specific event, including counts and top emojis.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists highlights, optionally filtered by match.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific highlight by its ID.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_featured_highlights(self, limit: int = 10)
methods.description: Retrieves highlights marked as featured, ordered by view and creation count.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
